stories.title: 25 new prosecutors half to what is needed to make ‘meaningful change’ on Manitoba Crown workloads
stories.summary: The provincial government is adding several Crowns over three and a half years, but one attorney says it's still far off from meaningful change.

stories.title: Manitoba health minister concerned about U.S. measles cases
stories.summary: As health officials praise Canada for moving in the right direction to combat measles, they're also warning of concerning trends in other countries.

stories.title: Woman accused of murder in death of 70-year-old man in Winnipeg
stories.summary: A 43-year-old woman is facing a second-degree murder charge in relation to the Oct. 20 death of 70-year-old Richard James Boychuk.

stories.title: Ontario fugitive arrested in Winnipeg hours after making most wanted list
stories.summary: An Ontario fugitive wanted in connection with two Toronto-area shootings was arrested in Winnipeg Thursday, less than six hours after being placed on Canada’s most wanted list.

stories.title: Morrissey’s OT winner lifts Winnipeg Jets past Islanders 4-3
stories.summary: Josh Morrissey scored his first goal of the season at 1:58 of overtime as the Winnipeg Jets picked up two points in a game in which they never had the lead.

stories.title: Alouettes place eight players on All-CFL team
stories.summary: Montreal Alouettes quarterback Davis Alexander and receivers Tyson Philpot and Tyler Snead earned All-CFL all-star honours Thursday.

stories.title: Report into deadly Manitoba plane crash raises concerns about weight balance, fuel
stories.summary: The report says the weight balance could have made the plane more sensitive to fly, and significantly harder to recover from a stall.

stories.title: Blue Bombers fire Mike O’Shea after 12 seasons: ‘it was the right time’
stories.summary: Chief executive officer Wade Miller announced this morning the CFL club is moving on from Mike O'Shea after 12 seasons as head coach.

stories.title: Up to $650K offered for 8 fugitives on Canada’s most wanted list
stories.summary: Rewards totaling up to $650,000 are being offered for information leading to the arrests of eight fugitives on Canada's most wanted list.

stories.title: University of Winnipeg awarded national volleyball championship
stories.summary: The Winnipeg Wesmen will host the 2030 U Sports Men's Volleyball National Championship.
